fast_slow_tile_bit_sweep.title: Tile Weight Bit Sweep (T267 base, rank=32, constantstepideal)

lines.label: Slow tile (C) sweep — Fixed Condition (A/B=10bit, T267 params)
lines.description: C tile c_dw_min varies to change bit resolution. All other params fixed at T267 (lr=0.00328, tlr=0.25, te=2, flr=0.3, abml=10). NOT per-bit optimized — same hyperparameters across all C bit levels.

lines.label: Fast tile (A/B) sweep — Per-Bit Optimized (C=10bit fixed)
lines.description: Each A/B bit level independently optimized for lr, tlr, te, flr via optuna. C tile fixed at 10bit (c_dw_min=0.001953). rank=32 fixed. w_max=0.0624 fixed; ab_dw_min = 2*0.0624/2^abml.

source.base: T267 params (rank=32, abml=10, decay, onehot constantstepideal, F1=84.98)

noise_ratio_sweep.title: Noise Ratio Sweep — Fixed Condition (T267 constantstepideal, 10bit-optimized)
noise_ratio_sweep.description: All trials share T267's optimized hyperparameters (lr, tlr, te, flr). Only 6T1C noise params (dtod, std) scale with ratio. Gamma fixed at 6T1C reference (gamma_ratio=1.0). NOT per-ratio optimized — same condition across all noise levels.
noise_ratio_sweep.base_config: T267 from abml qkvo study (constantstepideal, F1=84.98). Fixed: rank=32, abml=10, ab_dw_min=1.2109e-4, c_dw_min=0.001953 (w_max=0.0624). Optimized at 10bit: lr=0.00328, tlr=0.25, te=2, flr=0.3.

asymmetry_ratio_sweep.title: Asymmetry Ratio Sweep — Fixed Condition (T267 constantstepideal, 10bit-optimized)
asymmetry_ratio_sweep.description: All trials share T267's optimized hyperparameters (lr, tlr, te, flr). Only gamma_up/gamma_down scale with ratio. All noise params = 0. gamma=0 = T267 baseline (constantstepideal, F1=84.98, injected). NOT per-ratio optimized — same condition across all gamma levels.
asymmetry_ratio_sweep.base_config: T267 from abml qkvo study (constantstepideal, F1=84.98). Fixed: rank=32, abml=10, ab_dw_min=1.2109e-4, c_dw_min=0.001953 (w_max=0.0624). Optimized at 10bit: lr=0.00328, tlr=0.25, te=2, flr=0.3.

gamma_wmax_2d_sweep.title: Gamma Ratio x w_max 2D Sweep (T267 constantstepideal base, fixed 10bit)
gamma_wmax_2d_sweep.description: All trials share T267's optimized hyperparameters (lr=0.00328, tlr=0.25, te=2, flr=0.3). abml=10 fixed (bit count constant). ab_dw_min varies to achieve target w_max. Gamma and w_max independently varied. NOT per-cell optimized — same hyperparameters across all (gamma, w_max) combinations. Baseline: (gamma=0, w_max=0.0624) = T267 (F1=84.98, injected).
gamma_wmax_2d_sweep.base_config: T267 from abml qkvo study (constantstepideal, F1=84.98). Fixed: rank=32, abml=10, ab_dw_min=1.2109e-4, c_dw_min=0.001953 (w_max=0.0624). Optimized at 10bit: lr=0.00328, tlr=0.25, te=2, flr=0.3.
